original:
Let $a>b\geq 1$ and $s\geq 1$ be integers.

(i) 

If $6s\leq b+1$ , then

 $R(T_{a,b},\mathbb{Z}_{a+b})\geq 2a+s-1.$ 

More generally, let $T$ be a tree with $m$ edges and bipartition sizes
 $t_{1}\leq t_{2}$ , let $L,s\geq 1$ , and suppose that for some vertex $c$ each
component of $T-c$ has at most $L$ vertices and that $T-c$ contains a
matching of size $s$ . If

 $\deg_{T}(c)>m/2\qquad\text{and}\qquad L(L+1)s\leq t_{1},$ 

then $R(T,\mathbb{Z}_{m})\geq 2t_{2}+s-1$ .
